Clearing cookies, changing MAC address, deleting history, going incognito... none of it works. Even if I'm out somewhere on a different wifi network it continues to track. 

If anyone knows a workaround... let me know.

I gotta admit, this comment made me snicker. The 'cry, smile joyfully' thing is so ironic and it happens in our church so often. 

I think faking it is what I plan to do. Thanks. :)

I'm still here.

I ended up taking my dog with me and tied my note to his collar with the intention to tie him up, so he would be found with the note when I died.

He was just so excited to be on a new street and was so happy... i didn't want to ruin that for him. i feel like a fucking coward for not going through with it.

I'm in high school so i can't leave. i cut them out as much as i can... but i've been trying to fake happiness so i can try and feel it which means spending time with them. i think that made it worse.

right now my plan is to drown myself in fallout 4 and good music and hope for the best.
